I've successfully made all three changes to the "Add Job Vacancy" modal!

Here’s a quick summary of what was updated:
1. **Experience Dropdown**: Replaced the basic text input with a predefined dropdown featuring ranges like `Fresher`, `1-2 Years`, `2-3 Years`, etc. I also integrated the "Other" option—when selected, it seamlessly reveals a custom text box to let you manually enter any range, just like in the Project Category dropdown.
2. **Salary Range**: Appended "(in LPA)" to the Salary Range label to clarify the expected unit for the user.
3. **Job Description Counter**: Enabled the `(0/5000)` counter next to the "Job Description" label which updates dynamically as you type, and strictly enforced a `5000` character limit on the text area. 

These updates are live across both the Admin and Public components (`src/admin/js/app.js` and `public/js/app.js`), keeping your application fully synchronized. You can test them out directly by opening the Add Job modal!
